description: Period Plume is a date slicer drawn over the trend of a measure. Drop your date column in Date and a measure in Measure (trend): users see the curve while they choose the period, so peaks, gaps and seasonality are visible before they filter. FREE, NO WATERMARK - Business presets: last 7, 30 or 90 days, this month, last month, this quarter, last quarter, last 6 months, year to date, last year, last 12 months, all time (each one can be turned on or off) - Rolling presets saved as relative date filters: "Last 30 days" is still the last 30 days after the next refresh - Reference date: today, or the last date in the data for historical datasets - Draw the period on the timeline, drag the window, move the start and end handles - Start / end date boxes with typed dates and a calendar - Timeline as area, line or bars; automatic granularity from day to year, or fixed - Monthly and yearly data detected automatically: presets and labels adapt ("5 years", "March 2024") - Default period applied when the report opens without a date filter - Apply on mouse release or with an Apply / Cancel button - Bookmarks, sync slicers, keyboard handles, screen readers, high contrast, themes, English and French - Custom colors: background, text, grid, accent, favorable / unfavorable, 8 series and a 3-color gradient; Minimal and Black & White styles PREMIUM (★, additional purchase) - Comparison with the…
